name: Lawrence (Indiana, United States)
description: Red upper part with five white stars and a white outline of the historic Fort Benjamin Harrison flag, over a navy blue lower part divided by a curved white line, charged with a white star flanked by wings.
history: Lawrence is a city in Lawrence Township, Marion County, Indiana. The flag was adopted on 6 December 2019 (according to the Wikidata statement on the flag).

features.role: curved line dividing the field and the outline of a flag
